events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect sender check script and key files (names only)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs; sed -n 1,80p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs; ls -la ~/.config/tantra/keys/ | awk '{print $1,$NF}'; grep -o 'TANTRA[A-Z_]*=' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; wc -c < ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the FintechCircle sender list
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i 'sender' workshop-plan/ops/t056_cold_calendar.mjs | head -20; grep -n -i 'senders\|@' workshop-plan/dogfooding/FINTECHCIRCLE_EXPERIMENT.md | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search repo for FintechCircle sender addresses
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rhoiE '[a-z0-9._+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]*fintech[a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]+' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40; grep -n 'T-263' scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | head
